2irie has worked with and is supported by artists like; Major Lazer, Diplo, South Rakkas Crew, Grammy winning producer Sr. Mendez, Grammy nominee MC Zulu, Blanquito Man of King Chango, Anthony B, Junior Kelly, Chong X, Gato Preto, Geko Jones, Uproot Andy, Pocz & Pacheko, OneChot, MKC, Patafunk, and Venezuelan hip hop star Reke amongst others.
MkC feat. 2irie- FRIDAY
2irie 
Bridgetown, Barbados
It all started in August of 2011 with the release of his self-titled debut album "2irie" off Miami based label El Flying Monkey Records.
When it comes to putting versatile vocals and multi-cultural production on a tropical bass vibe, 2irie is one of the hidden gems of the international underground scene.
bring his particular style of reggae and soca influenced bass music to the next level
Celebrating this new direction in his career, he released the new moombahton single "Latino Mafia" in collaboration with Venezuelan bossman producer Tropikore off the South American net label Le Ronca Records
This dancehall/cumbia bass combination helped him earn even more respect from his Venezuelan peers and reach a wider international audience.
Half Barbadian and half English with an adopted "Latino" status after living in Venezuela for over a decade, Christopher "2irie" Harris has earned his place in this ever growing world of bass music.
After 13 years mashing up the scene in Venezuela, 2irie returns to Barbados to rediscover his roots and bring his particular style of reggae and soca influenced bass music to the next level.
